subject.title: fix(discord): preserve tool updates when progress preview is empty

question: Should Discord progress mode suppress standalone text-only tool updates only after a visible progress draft starts, with an empty-preview update flushed before the final response?
rationale: The branch chooses a user-visible delivery policy between preview ownership, standalone progress visibility, and duplicate avoidance; tests can validate mechanics, but maintainers must confirm that this is the intended Discord experience.

options.title: Adopt visible-lane suppression
options.body: Approve the state-based policy after live Discord proof shows fast-tool visibility and duplicate-free long-running progress.

options.title: Preserve preview-only ownership
options.body: Keep unconditional progress-mode suppression and close or redesign the regression request if standalone fallback updates are not desired.

recommendation.title: Adopt visible-lane suppression
recommendation.body: Approve the state-based policy after live Discord proof shows fast-tool visibility and duplicate-free long-running progress.
